record.body:
## Problem

No workflow runs the test suite, lint, store validation, or skill sync on push or pull request. Only `tuner-verdict.yml` runs, and it covers one fixture. A broken change reaches `main` without a signal.

## Approach

Add one GitHub Actions workflow on push and pull request, separate from `tuner-verdict.yml`. A `checks` job runs `scripts/build_skills.py --check`, `scripts/check_orchestra_plugin_names.py`, `canon validate`, `uv lock --check`, `ruff check` with a narrow pinned rule set in `pyproject.toml`, `ruff format --check`, and `actionlint`. Test jobs run the `scripts/test.sh` passes in parallel with `-n auto` and uv caching. A separate job installs tmux and runs the `tmux` marker serially. A `types` job runs mypy without blocking. The workflow sets top-level `permissions: contents: read`, pins third-party actions to a commit SHA, sets `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress`, and sets `timeout-minutes` on each job. A path filter skips the test and types jobs when a change touches only `.canon/`. One summary job is the required check, so skipped jobs do not block a merge. Settle details at settle-phase.

## Exit criteria

- The workflow runs on a pull request and every blocking job passes (observed GitHub Actions run on the phase branch).
- A deliberate failure in each blocking job (test, ruff, `canon validate`, skill drift, lockfile drift) turns the run red (observed run or `act` dry run per job).
- A pull request that changes only `.canon/` skips the test jobs, and the summary check still passes (observed GitHub Actions run).
- `actionlint` reports no errors on `.github/workflows/` (command).
- `scripts/test.sh` still passes locally (command).
